title: Bridging Bounds for Random Injections and Permutations
summary: Known lower and upper bounds leave a gap for random injections and permutations; the unresolved task is to bridge it.

formal_statement.body: We leave bridging this gap between the lower and upper bounds for random injections (and indeed also permutations) as the main open problem in this area.

scope.domain: Combinatorial and probabilistic analysis of random injections and permutations.
parameters: random injections and permutations, the objects for which bounds are studied
scope.unresolved_remainder: Bridge the gap between the lower and upper bounds for random injections and permutations.

progress.summary: The source explicitly identifies bridging the gap between the lower and upper bounds for random injections and permutations as the main open problem in the area.
citation_labels: Manuel Barbosa et al., Indifferentiable Authenticated Encryption
